title: ExecutionEvent
description: Standard schema for execution lifecycle events emitted by Person 1's Execution Adapter for consumption by Person 2 (Quant Alpha) and Person 3 (Risk Gateway).

event_type.description: Lifecycle transition type of the execution event.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was emitted.

order_result.description: Detailed execution outcome corresponding to the submitted order intent.

client_intent_id.description: Unique client-side intent identifier corresponding to OrderIntent.intent_id.

action.description: Order action side permitted by exchange API.

quantity.description: Intended order quantity. Must be a strictly positive integer.

order_id.description: Platform-assigned order ID string if successfully acknowledged by exchange.

execution_price.description: Execution fill price per share in INR if filled or partially filled.

filled_quantity.description: Number of shares filled so far (0 for pending, rejected, or unknown).

charges.description: Total brokerage, commission, and platform fees in INR.

rejection_reason.description: Detailed rejection or error reason if status is REJECTED or UNKNOWN.

requires_reconciliation.description: Flag indicating outcome uncertainty requiring account or position reconciliation.

raw_response.description: Raw JSON dictionary returned by exchange endpoint if available.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the order outcome.

extra.description: Optional metadata dictionary containing strategy_id, risk_authorization_id, or client telemetry.

strategy_id.description: Identifier of the alpha strategy generating the trade (Person 2 provenance).

risk_authorization_id.description: Authorization token or HMAC signature issued by Person 3's risk gateway.

allOf.description: When status is UNKNOWN, requires_reconciliation must be true.
When status is REJECTED, rejection_reason must be provided as a non-empty string.
When status is FILLED, filled_quantity must be greater than zero.
When event_type is ORDER_UNCERTAIN, status must be UNKNOWN.
